claims.text: Gléowine composed an immortalising song about Théoden and his ancestors after the Battle of the Pelennor Fields. It was said that he never composed another song afterwards.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "Many Partings"

claims.text: In early drafts, Gléowine was named Gleowin.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), Sauron Defeated, "Part One: The End of the Third Age: VII. Many Partings"
